entries.30ffdc0ea8de9cff: In the Toraja area of Sulawesi Island, Indonesia, the company has a procurement system in which its local subsidiary PT.TOARCO JAYA handles everything from farm management to collecting, purchasing and refining green coffee beans, which are manufactured and sold as “TOARCO TORAJA.” Building on roasting technology developed since its founding in 1920, the company has established a quality system in which all plants have obtained certification under the food safety management system FSSC22000. For restaurants, the company also combines support beyond product sales, such as technical instruction and menu development assistance drawing on the know-how of its coffee school, which marked the 70th anniversary of its opening.

entries.3e682b0ac4ad6d48: Based on a quality-first principle, the company's basic policy is to take on the value chain from cultivating and processing coffee to delivering it safely to customers. As its near-term management strategy, the company is working on three initiatives: strengthening earnings capacity, strengthening its management foundation and strengthening overall group capabilities. Its stated challenges include establishing a robust earnings base less affected by changes in the external environment, expanding new businesses and business areas, realizing sustainability and maximizing the value of human capital, and ensuring food safety and responding to unforeseen circumstances. The company sets out its target image for 2030 as a sustainable company of “coffee and KISSA.”
